entries.title: Home Mist with Lemongrass + Grapefruit Water
entries.evidence: Official UpCircle PDP identifies this row as Home Mist with Lemongrass + Grapefruit Water at the room-spray URL. The reviewed official description positions it as a home mist for spaces and the recovered how-to directs spraying it on fabrics, curtains, carpets, cushions, or as a bathroom spray.
